requirements: Your product must run a REAL affiliate/referral program — this is a directory of affiliate programs, not products
Rejected: gambling/betting, traditional MLM/pyramid (standard 2-tier is fine), adult, get-rich-quick schemes, companies with no active customers/real usage

Program launch year, affiliate signup URL, social links
